title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "I just hope this isn't another wild turtle chase!" —Vernon Fenwick
"Utroms . . . Triceratons . . . there's little difference to me. I help one destroy the other, pick up the pieces, then get them the hell off of my planet."
"Never been defeated, huh? Well, you never tangled with a turtle before!" —Donatello
Azrael was born on the wind to guide others to new beginnings.
"HI! I'm Pete!"
"Of course I know what you did! You always do precisely what I told you not to do!"
"Everything you know, I have shown you, but I have not shown you everything I know."
"Nice to meet you, Botticelli . . . or whatever your name is. Tell your boss to send some scarier goons next time." —Ace Duck
"Splinter said that, once, ninjas defended the poor and the weak from power. We could be real ninjas. We can fight for the people!"
"Hello, prey."
They stood beside him. Whether they were figments or true spirits no longer mattered.
"That's right. Eyes on me."
For a moment, there is only relentless snow and frozen breath.
"Yer right. We're just a scrappy band of mutants. We can't win. But boy, can we stir up trouble." —Old Hob
"As far as I'm concerned, Pepperoni's one of us!" —Raphael
"I wanna make things better for everyone. No more squalor. No more fear."
"For the glory of the Republic!"
Other perspectives can help one find the proper direction.
In the fight between mutants, ninjas, and aliens, don't underestimate a resourceful human.
"Freelance reporting pays even worse than tutoring, but the satisfaction of uncovering the truth makes it all worth it! Also the free ringside tickets to cover intergalactic wrestling don't suck."
Designed for autonomous pollination, the Stocktronics buzz bot's souped-up power plant allows for months of independent service. The optional taser is for defensive purposes only, of course.
"Wondering what I've got in the box? Pain, soldier! And lots of it!" —Herman
"My son, for someone so intelligent, the obvious often eludes you." —Splinter
"Unfortunately, the lowly turtle has been saddled by society with the stereotype of being velocity challenged."
"I'll need my bag of tricks."
A freak accident transferred Professor Honeycutt's mind into his robot assistant. Blamed for his own death, he fled . . . as the FUGITOID!
"Like a monster seeking prey in the night, the truth will hunt you down."
Metalhead simulates dozens of fighting styles, including Foot ninjutsu.
"You will experience some discomfort. Then, for better or worse, the concepts of comfort and discomfort will become quite alien." —Fugitoid
"Stealth-o-rama, huh? Righteous."
"You guys seriously try to do this with jump kicks?"
Lab safety is everyone's business.
"You guys don't get sick during time travel, do you?"
"We strike hard and fade away into the night." —Leonardo
No one in New York was going to notice one more cockroach.
Using exoskeletons and false skins, the utroms took up residence on Earth after their ship crashed. Returning home using only Earth's primitive technology has proven challenging.
"Question: Do you like penicillin on your pizza?" —Donatello
Often enemies, always brothers . . . till the end.
"We've drained human life force for millennia. Then one day, turtles! Delectable! We'll suck you dry and spit out the shells!"
Mashima would protect the soul of Oroku Saki at any cost.
"We suffered a bit of a setback tonight, but rest assured: We'll have the planet purged and primed for you right on schedule."
Your instructor is Casey Jones!
"When I am done, there will be no evidence that you ever existed!"
The Kuro Kabuto has been the symbol of Foot Clan leadership since its inception over 1,500 years ago.
"Tonight I dine on turtle soup."
"Possess the right thinking. Only then can one receive the gifts of strength, knowledge, and peace."
It's best to never discover what they squirrel away.
"These guys are good!" —Leonardo
"I have molded myself into perfection, Hamato. Look upon me, and know fear."
The Rat King's subjects are everywhere you don't want to be.
"Well, I'd say we redecorated the place nicely!" —Raphael
The power of the Foot is its ability to infiltrate every system from the shadows.
"Goongala!"
"Lord Krang, we arrive. We obey. We conquer."
It was fitting that the most dangerous turtle bore a weapon of peace.
"I want rock 'n' roll, man! Lucky I brought my own drumsticks . . ." —Casey Jones
"Being a mutant isn't easy. Lucky for me, I've been preparing for this my entire life!"
"SAY YER PRAYERS, TOITLES!"
"For me, all things remain strictly business. And today's business happens to be extermination!" —Baxter Stockman
"Hmmm . . . How many should I send? Three? Five? Ten, maybe!" —Baxter Stockman
After the Bomb's take on thrash metal isn't for everyone . . . and Sheena wouldn't have it any other way.
"I'm a company woman. I'm part of the plan. I'm part of the team. And I enjoy my work." —Zodi
"This is us against them, plain and simple. Either you're with us, or . . ."
"These guys are young, but no rookies. They've fought and beat everything on two legs in this area . . . except us." —Leonardo
"You guys must be studying the abridged book of ninja fighting."
"Time to punch in."
"Anger is a dangerous ally. It clouds your judgment. You need to control it, lest it control you." —Splinter
"Change of plans!"
"The mousers have a new command: to consume everything here . . . all of you will be destroyed!" —Baxter Stockman
Catching enemies between a rock and a hard place.
"Tell 'em you've got a new partner. One who knows the true meaning of being a warrior."
"Yeah, I threw in some habaneros to cut the heat on this." —Raphael
"Tell me, Screwloose, aren't we good? Mmhm. So, wouldn't that make them evil? Right!"
Forgiveness is divine, but never pay full price for late pizza.
When you're open to new things, a weird world of wonder unfolds before you.
"With faithful Alberto's assistance, this shall be a gathering of untold delight! Why would you ever wish to leave?" —Toad Baron
"Whatever my lil' man D.B. here can't dig under, I can just about bust through. Ain't no one caging us ever again."
"There is no fear in my heart. I will overcome even this challenge!" —Leonardo
"A teacher must be ready to accept responsibility for the student, especially when the student is a weirdo." —Splinter
"I felt kind of excited about being mutated, you know? I was getting to have this once in a lifetime experience! Maybe I could even base my thesis on it . . ."
"We live together, we train together, we fight together, we stand together . . . We are ninjas."
"Uno, Moja, Odyn, and Yi carry on the brothers' legacy. New York will be free once more."
"Have at me, and we will find out who is the fittest among us." —Manmoth
Bebop and Rocksteady's new Cretaceous stowaway quickly developed a taste for leftovers . . . and ears.
"I LOVE being a turtle!" —Michelangelo
"Get back, all ya'll! Stay away from me! I ain't safe, ya hear! Ain't no friend! I'm a monster!"
Unnoticed by the crowd, the strange canister bounced several more times, striking and smashing a glass jar which held four small turtles . . .
Built from scraps. Defined by self.
They imagine that out beyond the zoo, beyond the pen, there exists another world, and it encroaches with rapid certainty upon their own . . .
"You flatter me, Ms. O'Neil. I like that."
"They'll beat you with fists, with a bat, with a knife. / So don't try to stop them, just run for your life! / Get set and get ready, / For Bebop and Rocksteady!"
Technician. Tactician.
"Rest your brains, Donnie, I got my own idea."
Not all humans fear the unknown. The Earth Protection Force specializes in teaching the unknown to fear them instead.
The Foot Elite are the personal students of the Shredder, a reserve guard without equal.
"Free our brothers! The human reign of terror around here ends tonight!"
"That's not what they mean by 'pet food,' dude!" —Michelangelo
"Everyone's got their own strengths, Lita. You never know what cards they might play. Instead, focus on what you know and never doubt your choices." —Michelangelo
"This is absolutely ridiculous, Saki! They aren't meant for riding! What happened to the ninja's famous subtlety?" —Baxter Stockman
Their strength hailed not from what they shared, but from how their differences complemented one another.
Designed to get rodents out of small spaces, its Mouser maws can be used to seize all sorts of vermin!
"I don't need a name. I'm nobody."
Glyph has claimed to be a survivor of an alien war, a deposed minister of weather, and the last of the dinosaurs. Whatever the truth, his origin stories always bear a lesson.
"Weirdo ninjas got some nerve showing up on our turf. Sayin' they don't wanna fight but they got swords and stuff. Heh."
"Beats working in the sewers. Too many freaky mutants down there." —Muckman
At odds as brothers, perfectly in sync as fighters.
"The Slithery! He's snatches little kids an' keeps 'em in cages! He don't got no legs and just slithers." —Lita
"The first rule of the ninja is 'do no harm.' Unless you need to do harm. Then do lots of harm!"
"Spray them with the anti-mutagen? No, no. I'm afraid ingestion is the only course." —Dr. Jordan Perry
"Master say have fun . . ."
"Apologies for the disturbance, [INCIDENTAL WITNESS], have a pleasant day!"
The Molecular Amplification technology of Krang's exo-suit allows him to expand and adapt not only his tactics, but his physical form.
"And just a sprig of parsley for color . . ." —Michelangelo
"Why skate a half-pipe when you can skate a sewer pipe?"
Even unfinished, the Technodrome was magnificent, a wonder of alien technology.
"Hey, in crazy backwards land, crazy backwards dude is king." —Michelangelo
"I hear the sewers in Connecticut are really nice." —Michelangelo
"Getting inside will be easy. Getting to Shredder might even be doable. Getting back out? That's going to be hard." —April O'Neil
Their recipe isn't the only secret.
"Until we completely understand the mutagenic agent's effects, these people must remain contained for our health and safety." —Baxter Stockman
The light from the Translocation Matrix could be seen throughout the city. The utroms knew they only had a brief window to escape after its accidental activation.
Home is where your pizza delivers.
"See you on the other side, bros."
"We Turtles don't know the meaning of the word defeat."
"I got no problem with you, but I think my friends here just might . . ."
"I can figure this out! Don't worry about me—ow!"
"I've been working on a pan-dimensional portal of my own. It's the real thing. Of course, I haven't actually tested it yet . . ."
"Who needs Foot soldiers? I can subdue you with your own fancy footwork."
"You don't have to explain it to me, I'm the one who invented it!"
"So sorry to bring our game to an early conclusion. You wouldn't have won anyway."
"Behold the secret technique only taught to true masters of the Foot Clan."
"Maybe they've forgotten what a great scientist I used to be, but I don't forget."
"I'll teach you criminals to befoul our sewers!"
"Of course it's dangerous. That's the whole point of a weapon!"
"Alright, time out! Who's fighting who again?"
"Mosey along, critters. You're blockin' my way!" —Groundchuck
"Drop in anytime, micro-dudes."
April's Turtle tots: Moja, Odyn, Uno, and Yi.
"We got a score to settle with you little twerps."
"Hey, watch it, Leonardo. You're ruining my finish!"
A good ninja can defend themselves with anything.
"The ninja who loses his temper, loses the battle." —Karai
"Face it, Leo, this is the only job we're qualified for."
The Path of the Four Winds is a quest for knowledge. South to the serpent. West to the Jaguar. North to the dragon. East to the eagle.
"You losers better talk, or else I'm gonna get sarcastic!" —Raphael
"You have corrupted my teachings. Now you will pay for your crimes."
"Master say have fun!"
"See you around the multiverse, bros." —One Leonardo or another
"You hunger for retribution, I know. And so I come to you with an offering . . ."
"When are we now?" —Donatello
"I am ancient efficiency. I am evolution's future. I am mutation come full, vicious circle!"
Snake-Eyes's gift takes others back to their worst memory. To the weak, it is a curse; to the wise, a second chance.
The nature of a giant, disembodied cyborg cow head that travels through time and space raises countless questions. But Cudley doesn't like talking with his mouth full.
"Broadcast: Seized. Initiate seek-and-destroy protocols."
